The reviewer wrote, “this pipeline is well–behaved” — and she meant it sincerely. A naïve approach would ignore the café sign’s accents, but our tokenizer keeps every byte. He said it’s ‘obvious’ once you see it; the résumé of changes spanned 2018–2024.

The façade of simplicity hides care: “don’t” and “it’s” use a curly apostrophe here. From naïveté to expertise — a long road – the team kept the contract opaque and stable. She quoted the motto ‘measure twice’ and added a wry, almost playful, “then measure again.”
